description: Election Commission - Declare that Sivabalasingam Vimalanantharani was Selected as the member of the Point Pedro Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government authority (Point Pedro Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
